entities.name: Paliano
entities.description: Capital city-state of Fiora, raised on an enormous platform above the Lowlands.

entities.name: King Brago
entities.description: Ruler of Paliano for many years, first as a human and later as a spirit.

entities.name: Custodi
entities.description: Brago's advisors who helped him attain immortality.

entities.name: Muzzio
entities.description: Made a bid for power that led to cogwork being eliminated from the city.

entities.name: Marchesa d'Amati
entities.description: Hired an assassin to kill Brago and took over Paliano as queen.

entities.name: Adriana Vallore
entities.description: Brago's former guard captain who fomented a rebellion against Marchesa.

entities.name: Daretti
entities.description: Goblin planeswalker who instigated riots among goblins in Paliano.

entities.name: New Phyrexian Invasion
entities.description: Invasion in which Paliano was a target.

entities.name: City Guard of Paliano
entities.description: Police of the city, disbanded after a change in leadership.

events.summary: Brago seizes power and rules Paliano; he and the Custodi close the Academy to eliminate opponents.
events.quote: The King and his Custodi advisors closed down the Academy using the opportunity to eliminate those who stood against him.

events.summary: Brago attains immortality as a spirit with his advisors' help.
events.quote: he attained immortality with the help of his advisors which inadvertently freed him from his body as a spirit
Brago was killed by Selvala of Alberon

events.summary: Marchesa hires Kaya Cassir to eliminate Brago for good.
events.quote: hired the ghost assassin Kaya Cassir to eliminate the king for good

events.summary: Adriana Vallore foments a rebellion against Queen Marchesa.
events.quote: Adriana Vallore fomented a rebellion against the new queen's reign

events.summary: Daretti instigates goblin riots, but Marchesa's rule survives.
events.quote: However, these events were not successful in overthrowing her rule.

events.summary: During the New Phyrexian Invasion, Marchesa refuses all trespassers.
events.quote: Queen Marchesa refused all who trespassed.
